label: Dispatching a research task without first `ls`-ing the sibling results/ dir to see if it's already answered
why: Before dispatching a research/agent task, ls the sibling results/ directory — the answer may already exist on disk. Spawning a fresh research run (Agent / cmux spawn / dispatch_to_agent / cursor-agent) without that ls duplicates work and risks contradicting an existing answer. The ls-siblings probe must precede the dispatch in the same turn.
